$comment: Single source of truth for who commits what. Files must be disjoint across packages. Directories include everything inside them. 'lead' commits all the logic and the base app from their own working tree. Packages with 'sourceRoot' are small extras whose files live outside the tree (ignored folder) until a contributor adds them. Run `npm run handoff -- verify` after editing.

packages.title: Stellar core: network config, hashing and authorship registry
packages.summary: The heart of the product: SHA-256 content fingerprint, the manageData registration transaction, and reading a certificate back from Horizon.

commit.subject: Add Stellar core: config, content hashing and authorship registry
commit.body:
Hash content with SHA-256 in the browser, anchor it on Stellar with a
manageData operation, and read certificates back from Horizon so anyone
can verify them without trusting Staries.

packages.title: License payments, wallet signing hooks and Testnet smoke test
packages.summary: Direct author payments, the hook that signs with the connected wallet, Friendbot funding, and an end-to-end script that proves the core works on Testnet.

commit.subject: Add license payments, wallet signer hook and Testnet smoke test
commit.body:
Payments go buyer -> author with no intermediary. useStellarSigner delegates
signing to the connected wallet (Staries never sees private keys).
`npm run smoke` exercises register -> verify -> tamper -> pay on Testnet.

packages.title: Domain model and library store
packages.summary: Types for Stars, chapters, registrations and purchases, plus the persisted zustand store that holds off-chain data.

commit.subject: Add domain model and persisted library store
commit.body:
Works, chapters (with versioned on-chain registrations) and license
purchases. Persisted in localStorage for the MVP behind a single store so
the backend can be swapped later.

packages.title: Brand foundation and UI kit
packages.summary: Design tokens from the Staries brand deck (teal #3F8293, star #FFD37D, ink #1E1E26), the official Staries and NOIR logos, the star shape and the shared UI primitives.

commit.subject: Add Staries brand tokens, logo and UI kit
commit.body:
Colors and typography follow the brand deck and user manual. Adds the
official Staries and NOIR logos, Logo, StarShape and the shared primitives (Button, Card, Badge, Field, Alert,
Spinner, EmptyState, Icon, PageShell).

packages.title: App shell and wallet gating
packages.summary: Root layout, branded navbar and footer, startup bootstrap (wallet kit + store hydration), and the RequireWallet / FundingNotice components.

commit.subject: Add branded app shell, navbar and wallet gating
commit.body:
Root layout with Montserrat, navbar with network badge and wallet pill,
footer, AppBootstrap, and RequireWallet/FundingNotice (one-click Testnet
funding through Friendbot).

packages.title: Landing page
packages.summary: Mission, pain points, how it works, before/after, offerings (live vs coming soon) and audience — adapted from the brand deck.

commit.subject: Add landing page based on the brand deck
commit.body:
Hero with a sample certificate, mission quote, pain points, how it works,
before/after comparison, offerings with live/coming-soon status, audience.

packages.title: Author studio: Stars and license pricing
packages.summary: My Stars list, New Star form and the Star management page with chapter list and license pricing.

commit.subject: Add author studio for Stars and license pricing
commit.body:
Authors create Stars, set per-license prices (commercial, translation,
adaptation) and manage chapters. Personal reading is always free.

packages.title: Chapter editor and publish-to-Stellar flow
packages.summary: Editor with live fingerprint, step-by-step publish progress, and versioned registrations (each changed publish adds a new certificate).

commit.subject: Add chapter editor with Publish & protect on Stellar
commit.body:
Live SHA-256 fingerprint while writing, wallet-signed registration with
progress steps, and versioning: every changed publish adds a certificate.

packages.title: Public certificate and verification
packages.summary: Certificate page read live from Horizon, the verify-a-text tool and the Verify entry page. No wallet or account needed.

commit.subject: Add public certificate page and text verification
commit.body:
Certificates are read straight from the Stellar network. Anyone can paste
a text and check it against the registered fingerprint in their browser.

packages.title: License purchase and activity history
packages.summary: License panel with direct on-chain payments to the author, and the Activity page with records, sales and purchases.

commit.subject: Add license purchase and activity history
commit.body:
Buyers pay the author directly on Stellar. Activity shows authorship
records, licenses sold, income and purchases with links to public proofs.

packages.title: Catalog, Star page and chapter reader
packages.summary: Explore with search and genre filters, the public Star page, and the reader that re-verifies the text against Stellar on every open.

commit.subject: Add catalog, Star page and verified chapter reader
commit.body:
Readers browse protected Stars, read chapters and see an automatic
"authorship verified" check that recomputes the fingerprint and compares it
with the record on Stellar.

packages.title: Documentation and contributor tooling
packages.summary: README, architecture notes, demo script, generated work-package guide and the handoff script.

commit.subject: Add documentation, demo script and handoff tooling
commit.body:
README, architecture decisions and limitations, 5-minute demo script,
work-package guide and the script used to split work between contributors.

packages.title: 404 page and loading screen
packages.summary: A friendly 404 and a branded loading screen. Two new files, picked up automatically by Next.js.

commit.subject: Add branded 404 page and loading screen
commit.body: Not-found page with links back home, and a pulsing star shown while pages load.

packages.title: Error page and catalog skeleton
packages.summary: A friendly error page plus a reusable Skeleton and a placeholder grid while the catalog loads.

commit.subject: Add error page, Skeleton and catalog loading placeholder
commit.body:
Error boundary with a try-again button, a reusable Skeleton block and a
placeholder grid for the Explore page.

packages.title: About and How it works pages
packages.summary: Why Staries exists, and a plain-language walkthrough of what happens when you publish. Pages at /about and /how-it-works.

commit.subject: Add About and How it works pages
commit.body:
Mission and values from the brand deck, and a five-step explanation of
fingerprint, signature, timestamp and certificate without jargon.

packages.title: FAQ and Glossary pages
packages.summary: Honest answers about proofs, keys, costs and licenses, plus a plain-language glossary. Pages at /faq and /glossary.

commit.subject: Add FAQ and Glossary pages
commit.body:
Collapsible questions about authorship proofs, keys, costs and licenses,
and definitions for the few technical terms users may meet.

packages.title: Roadmap and Legal notes pages
packages.summary: What is live and what is next, and the honest limits of what a certificate proves. Pages at /roadmap and /legal.

commit.subject: Add Roadmap and Legal notes pages
commit.body:
Live and upcoming features, and plain-language legal notes: what a
certificate is, what it is not, and the Testnet caveat.

packages.title: Wallet guide and Brand kit pages
packages.summary: Five steps to get a wallet ready, and a visual brand kit with logo, colors, type, star, buttons and badges. Pages at /wallet-help and /brand.

commit.subject: Add wallet guide and brand kit pages
commit.body:
Step-by-step guide to install Freighter, choose Testnet and get free coins,
and a brand kit page showing the logo, color palette and UI components.
